annotations.title: Check whether the owner accepted a request

description: Read one request by its requestId: pending, accepted, declined, quoted (amount, currency, slot, note), booked, declined_by_customer or expired. No chat card: the card from do updates itself. Call this only when the user asks, and only once. If it is still pending, say so and stop. A quote is an offer until the user accepts it on the card or with respond_to_quote. Nothing is paid. After the owner accepts, signedReceipt (id signedReceiptId) proves the outcome; keys at receiptKeysUrl.
name: request_status
title: Check whether the owner accepted a request
